name: Syndax Pharmaceuticals, Inc.
summary: Syndax Pharmaceuticals, Inc., a commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company, develops therapies for the treatment of cancer. Its lead product candidate includes Revuforj (revumenib), a menin inhibitor for the treatment of relapsed or refractory R/R acute leukemia; and Niktimvo (axatilimab-csfr), a colony stimulating factor-1 receptor blocking antibody to treat chronic graft-versus-host disease.
